summary.text: Ron Meinhardt, an independent registered nurse and small-business chief financial officer from Nowata County, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma to Kevin Hern.
He calls himself a conservative independent.

paragraphs.text: Meinhardt earned a bachelor's degree from Columbia Union College in 2005, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a CFO. In his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a registered nurse, small-business CFO, husband and father who has also studied public policy and administration at the graduate level.
He says he opposes the proposed Inola aluminum smelter, advocates for Oklahoma ranchers and wants informed local consent for major projects, including AI data centers.
During the campaign, he said he was running on applying the Constitution consistently, term limits, a ban on congressional stock trading, and opposition to the proposed Inola aluminum smelter.
He received 1.3% of the vote to Kevin Hern's 57.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
